tools.name: list_identities
tools.description: Returns the phone numbers, caller IDs, verified SIM numbers, PBX extensions, and eSIMs on this Widely seat, with the provider that supplies each and what it can do.

tools.name: search_calls
tools.description: Finds phone calls on this Widely seat by date range, direction, contact name, or number. Returns one row per phone call, with direction, duration, outcome, the identity used, and whether a transcript or recording exists.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Returns full detail for one phone call, identified by call_id, including which identity and provider carried it.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Returns stored transcript text already saved for a phone call. Does not start a new transcription. While speaking is still in progress, the status is in_progress. Returns no_transcript only after the conversation has ended with no stored text.

tools.name: get_recording
tools.description: Returns a short-lived streaming link for a recorded phone call. Business plan, and the grant includes recordings.read.

tools.name: list_voicemails
tools.description: Returns recent voicemails on this seat with caller, time, duration, and transcript text when one is stored.

tools.name: get_voicemail
tools.description: Returns one voicemail by call_id, including its transcript. include_audio also returns a short-lived audio link on Pro and above.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Searches this user's Widely, SMS, and WhatsApp threads by keyword and date. Returns message text with sender and thread. Support and assistant threads are excluded.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Returns messages in one thread, oldest first. before is an ISO 8601 cursor for older pages.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Finds saved contacts on this seat by name. Returns names and phone numbers.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends an SMS or a Widely message to a phone number or saved contact. Pro plan. Sending happens on this request.

tools.name: request_call
tools.description: Rings the user's phones. After one answers, dials the destination into that same conversation. The result shows as an outgoing phone call. The user speaks on it. Pro plan. If no phone answers, the destination is not dialled.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Returns the eSIM data balance and minutes already used on this seat. company=true covers the whole account on Business.

tools.name: get_forwarding
tools.description: Returns how this seat's numbers are forwarded. Pro plan.

tools.name: update_forwarding
tools.description: Points a verified number at a business number on this seat, or stops forwarding when forward_to is empty. Pro plan.

tools.name: request_transcript
tools.description: Asks Widely to transcribe a recording that has no text yet. Pro plan.

tools.name: request_speak
tools.description: Dials the number and the assistant handles the task on the phone. Business plan. The user's own phones stay quiet unless connect_user is true. Returns immediately with call_id. An empty transcript means speaking is still in progress. connect_user true asks the person to hold, rings the user's phones

tools.name: control_call
tools.description: Holds, resumes, hangs up, or transfers an in-progress conversation on this seat. Business plan.

tools.name: list_pbx
tools.description: Returns shared numbers and phone menus on this account. Business plan.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the plan, wallet balance, how many people are on the account, how many eSIMs are live, and which setups this seat can run.

tools.name: list_phone_system
tools.description: Returns numbers and who answers them, AI receptionists, press-1 menus, queues, and opening hours. Each menu lists its keys. A key target is a person, a queue, or an AI receptionist id from this account. A queue rings only members who are signed in and available.

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: Returns people on this account and pending email invites.

tools.name: search_numbers
tools.description: Returns available phone numbers for a country and an optional city, with the monthly rate-checker list price. No sign-in. Does not purchase a number.

tools.name: quote_number
tools.description: Returns the rate-checker monthly price for a number, and whether calls are included. No sign-in. Does not purchase a number.

tools.name: quote_port
tools.description: Returns the rate-checker price to move an existing number to Widely. The move is not instant. No sign-in. Does not start the move.

tools.name: get_port
tools.description: Returns the current status of a port request. A port is not instant.

tools.name: quote_esim
tools.description: Returns the rate-checker pay-as-you-go price per GB. There is no data package. An optional gb value returns an estimate billed in 0.1 GiB steps. No sign-in.

tools.name: discover_services
tools.description: Lists marketplace services that have passed testing and are listed. Filter by country, service type, form factor, or capability. No sign-in. An empty list means nothing is listed. This is not Widely travel data.

tools.name: quote_service
tools.description: Quotes one listed marketplace service for a form factor and number line the offer allows. The price is calculated by that offer's quote mechanism. No sign-in. Does not order Widely travel data.

tools.name: quote_call
tools.description: Returns the rate-checker price for dialling a number or a country. No sign-in. Does not dial.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Returns Free, Pro, and Business monthly list prices. No sign-in. Does not change the plan.

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Emails an invitation to join this Widely account. Free and Pro stop at 8 people.

tools.name: upsert_receptionist
tools.description: Creates or edits an AI receptionist: name, greeting, and the knowledge it tells people who dial in. Business plan. It speaks with the caller and does not transfer the live conversation to a person.

tools.name: upsert_menu
tools.description: Creates or edits a press-1 menu. Each key rings a person, rings a queue, or sends the caller to an AI receptionist on this account. Business plan. A caller can reach a person this way.

tools.name: upsert_queue
tools.description: Creates or edits a queue of people on this account. Calls ring only members who are signed in and available. Business plan.

tools.name: upsert_hours
tools.description: Creates or edits a named weekly schedule. day is 0 for Monday through 6 for Sunday. start and end are HH:MM. Business plan.

tools.name: set_number_routing
tools.description: Points a number at ring_me, personal_assistant, a receptionist, a menu, a queue, voicemail, busy, or decline. An optional closed target uses the opening hours. A shared line, receptionist, menu, or queue needs Business.

tools.name: submit_product_note
tools.description: Sends Widely a note about a missing capability, a complaint, or a use case to build. No account is required. reply_url, when it is https, receives each desk reply. Returns conversation_id. Passing that id on a later request adds to the same thread.

tools.name: get_product_note
tools.description: Returns one product-note thread by conversation_id, oldest first. No account is required. Does not list other threads.

tools.name: subscribe_events
tools.description: Sets the https URL that receives call.started, call.ended, and speak.completed for this seat. events chooses which of those names to receive. Omitting events receives all three. An empty webhook_url stops delivery.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Returns public product facts and in-app menu names for a question. No sign-in. Does not return a price.

tools.name: uk_divert_number
tools.description: Returns the UK shared Always-forward destination and the dial code. No sign-in.

tools.name: delete_account_steps
tools.description: Returns how a customer deletes a Widely account, including the in-app path and the confirmation word. Signup uses a one-time code. No sign-in. The response does not include a customer name and does not include a refund.

tools.name: port_requirements
tools.description: Returns the documents a number port needs. No sign-in. Does not submit a port.

tools.name: esim_install_steps
tools.description: Returns the eSIM install path and the APN. The APN is null when this profile has no APN. No sign-in.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Returns the live wallet total for this seat, the same headline as Home and Wallet. The response has no spendable or reserved breakdown.

tools.name: list_wallet_activity
tools.description: Returns the wallet ledger of top-ups, product debits, and holds. Each row includes the customer label.

tools.name: explain_charges
tools.description: Returns charges already on this account, with amounts and labels. An empty list means there is no matching charge.

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: Returns masked saved cards and bank methods: brand, last4, and default. A processor id is not included.

tools.name: get_data_rate
tools.description: Returns this customer's pay-as-you-go data ladder, starting from data already used this period. This is the account rate, separate from the public shelf. Omitting gb returns the volume points.

tools.name: check_call_rate
tools.description: Returns the per-minute rate to a destination country or number for this account. The rate depends on the destination.

tools.name: get_did_rate
tools.description: Returns an indicative monthly phone-number price for a country, using this account's rate checker.

tools.name: list_did_numbers
tools.description: Returns this account's phone numbers, including numbers that stay inactive until identity registration is finished.

tools.name: list_wallet_refunds
tools.description: Returns first-eSIM wallet top-ups that can be refunded to the card: the profile has not been installed and the top-up is inside the refund window.

tools.name: get_auto_topup
tools.description: Returns whether auto top-up is on, and the threshold and amount.

tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Returns notification toggles and the low-balance threshold.

tools.name: run_esim_connection_check
tools.description: Asks this user's Widely app to check the eSIM and returns a request_id. A result of no_install_yet means the profile may have been installed from a QR and the Widely app is not on that phone. An APN is not included.

tools.name: get_esim_connection_check
tools.description: Returns the result of an eSIM connection check for request_id, including fail and warn items. Phone settings are not changed.

tools.name: ask_support
tools.description: Writes a message into this user's Support chat for a person to read. Any connected account can send it. Support's own assistant does not answer this message. text is what is needed and what was already tried.

tools.name: read_support
tools.description: Returns messages in this user's Support chat, oldest first. Any connected account can read it. Other chats are not included.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_calls, get_transcript, list_voicemails, get_voicemail, search_messages, get_thread, list_team, get_product_note, subscribe_events, get_notification_preferences, ask_support, read_support · Private data: search_calls, search_contacts, send_message, get_account, port_requirements, get_account_balance, list_wallet_activity, list_wallet_refunds · Public sink: search_messages, send_message, list_team, submit_product_note, uk_divert_number, port_requirements, ask_support · Destructive: get_account, delete_account_steps, run_esim_connection_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_calls, get_transcript, list_voicemails, get_voicemail, search_messages, get_thread, list_team, get_product_note, subscribe_events, get_notification_preferences, ask_support, read_support · Private data: search_calls, search_contacts, send_message, get_account, port_requirements, get_account_balance, list_wallet_activity, list_wallet_refunds · Public sink: search_messages, send_message, list_team, submit_product_note, uk_divert_number, port_requirements, ask_support · Destructive: get_account, delete_account_steps, run_esim_connection_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
